Section.Title: Description
Section.Paragraph: The SetFrameBufferCaptureRegion method specifies the region of the bound framebuffer image to capture.

Section.Title: Usage
Section.Code: void SetFrameBufferCaptureRegion(const V2UInt32& imageOffsetInPixels = V2UInt32(0, 0), const V2UInt32& imageRegionInPixels = V2UInt32(0, 0));

ArgumentList.ArgumentListEntry: The top-left pixel offset of the framebuffer region to capture. An offset outside the framebuffer produces a successful capture with image dimensions of (0, 0).

The maximum pixel dimensions of the framebuffer region to capture. Each zero dimension captures the remaining image in that dimension from the offset. Nonzero dimensions are clipped to the available image region.
